tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /btsan rgod tse'u dmar po'i gtor ma'i las mtha' nyung tshang rno myur bzhugs so// na mo gu ru padma he ru kā ya/ mtha' bral chos dbyings snying rje'i mdangs/ /longs sku padma dbang chen te/ /sprul pa khro gtum gnod sbyin cher/ /btud do gong gi las mtha' bshad/ /'dir gnod sbyin chen po tse'u dmar por rgyud dang bka' gtad gsol kha sogs gter ma dag snang bka' ma sogs zin pa shin tu che ba zhig mchis kyang las mtha' mnan bsreg 'phang gsum la sngon chad zhal gsol yod pa zhig ma mthong yang / khyad chos tshang zhing spyir btang sngags gzhung spyi 'brel ltar la 'gal ba gang yang med pa ni rgyud dang rgya bod gzhung mang gsan gzigs mkhas grub gzu bor gnas pa thams cad kyis mkhyen 'gro ba bzhin gong sa thams cad mkhyen pa bdun pa chen po nyid slar yang bstan 'gro'i mgon por byon pa 'jam dpal mtshan can gyi bka' bzhin phran sa skya pa ngag dbang kun blos 'di'i 'dra 'bag 'chams sku 'dra ba khyad par gyi gzungs rab gnas bcas phul dus kyi gsol kha don 'dus dgos tshang nyid la slar yang bzhed pa bsgrub phyir gtor ma'i las mtha' nyung tshang rno myur 'di ltar zhabs 'gyur zhus rgyu'i sbyor ba yi dam chos srung mchod gtor dgos tshang gi sbyor ba ltar/ de'i mdun lcags snod du 'bru nag rjen phye/ dug khrag tsha ba gsum dang chang gis sbrus pa'i btsan bshos gru gsum zur rtse shin tu rno ba/ dbus su che ba dang mdun rgyab zur bzhir de'i phyed tsam slebs pas bskor bar mtheb kyu drug cu rtsa bzhi gcan gzan za 'phro 'dra ba kha phyir bstan gyis gtor chung rnams kyis phyed nub du bskor bar yungs dkar la tsher sdong sogs zang zing du btsugs shing / rgyu 'khor dang / skyer rtsang srin mo 'gro sogs gtor bzlog spyi 'gre/ mda' 'ug sgro skyer mde'u zur gsum glang dmar rgyus dkris dar dmar can btsugs par/

sha khrag la sgog tsha ba gsum sogs blug pa mañdzir lta bu'i khar dkyil gtor gyi heb sgrub sogs bsten pa bshams/ liṅga bsgral mchod gsol ka sogs dgos na bag zan las liṅga spyi 'gre lcags snod du bcas pa dang / dregs pa pho rgyud drag rdzas skam thun/ mo rgyud drag rdzas rlon thun gnyis med rgyud kyi drag rdzas phur gri sogs spyi 'gre ste sbyor ba'o/ /dngos gzhi bdag mdun dgos tshang du bshad pa'i skyabs 'gro nas bzung / phan bde'i sbrang rtsi dar brtan shog /bar/ de nas spos dkar sha tshil dud pa bshug sgra/ rkang gling rnga rol sogs 'jigs rngams bcas/ kyai gson cig gtum btsan mched bdun po/ /sprul pa yang sprul nyid sprul bcas/ /khams gsum srog bdud drag shul can/ /gdug can da lta sgrol bar bskul/ /zhes snyan gsan phab nas/ bsgral mchod ni/ gong gi liṅga sgrol chas bcas sgrub po'i mdun du bshams la/ e las 'brub khung gshin rje'i grang / /ṇi tri sri las dgra bgegs kun/ /so so'i gzugs brnyan nyam thag par/ /nad dug gshed mas bskor bar gyur/ /dzaḥrtsa gsum mchog gsum bden pa dang / /phyag sngags dmigs rdzas rten 'brel dang / /bdag cag dpon slob bden pa'i mthus/ /dmigs bya da lta nyid du khug /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes lan gsum sogs tshigs bcad dang spel/ bla ma'i byin rlabs yi dam srung / /'khor 'das dreg byed skyob byed dang / /rdzas sngags ting 'dzin kun bral te/ /mgon skyabs med pa nyid du gyur/ /zhes pas lha dbye/ kyai gzu dpang mdzod cig tse'u dmar/ /khyod ni snang srid dregs byed bdag /dgra bgegs 'di yis nyes pa dang / /bdag gis ma nyes zhal lce mdzod/ /ces pas bsgral bya'i nyes pa brjod cing sgrub po bden par bsgrubs/ kyai gtum rngams gsod la dga' ba rnams/ /do nub khyod kyi las skal shar/ /nad mtshon dug sogs mi 'dod kun/ /dgra bgegs 'dir phob rdul du rlog

/ces dang / dgos tshang du bshad pa'i gnod sbyin srog sngags de la/ sarba sha trūn bigdhān ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sbyar nas skam rlon thun dang phur gris dum bur byas la/ de'i rnam shes rta mgrin gyi thugs kar thim pas spang gnyen ro gcig gi go 'phang dang las ngan gsog pa'i rnam smin rten sha khrag rus dum gyis rnam par dmar myog dum bur btang bar dmigs nas/ zor gtor gyi mdun thod snod gsum sogs su bshams la khrag chang blugs nas gsol kha bya ba ni/ kyai bdag gis khyed bskul drag pos dgra bgegs bsgral/ /sha khrag don snod rus rkang phung por spungs/ /g.yang gzhi'i lhab lhub ro skra'i ban bun bcas/ /dreg byed kun tu dges pa 'di bzhes shig /ces gsol kha dang po bstabs/ gnyis pa ni/ kyai dmu rje legs pa gnod sbyin zangs 'dren ma/ /tse'u dmar mched bdun sras lcam blon 'bangs sogs/ /sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul snang srid bdag /bzhes shig dgra bgegs lus srog longs spyod bzhes/ /zhes bstabs/ gsum pa ni/ kyai rtsa gsum mchog gsum bka' dam rjes dgongs la/ /bdag cag mchod yon ltos par bcas kun gyi/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad kun las srungs/ /thun mong mchog bsam phrin las kun mdzod cig /ces bstabs/ de 'dra tshar gsum/ spro na 'og nas bskyor ro/ zor sgrub pa ni/ hūm̐ bdag nyid rta mgrin khro rgyal dang / /mdun gyi dregs byed thugs 'od kyis/ /srid zhi'i mthu stobs kun bsdus nas/ /zor chen la thim drag shul bskyed/ /kyai chos longs sprul pa'i rnam rol gyis/ /zor chen rdzas kyi mthu bskyed la/ /dgra bgegs srog la mnga' mdzad nas/ /gang la dmigs pa rdul du rlog /ces dang / oṃ hrīḥpadma ta kṛta badzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci rigs dang / gong gi gnod sbyin sngags sham bu can ci rigs bzlas mthar/ suṃ trig raksha bhyoḥthib thib tsakra bhyoḥsnying kha rag dun ti bhyoḥtri na shig

se na gtubs/ kha raka rbad dum bhyoḥbadzra ra ti raksha tsa tur mā ra ya hūm̐/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces thun sngags kyang ci rigs bcas kyis bsgrubs nas bskul ba ni/ rnga rol rkang gling bshug pa sogs dang bcas/ kyai 'jigs rung btsan gyi grong khyer na/ /'jigs rung gnod sbyin tse'u dmar che/ /'jigs rung cho 'phrul sna tshogs bcas/ /'jigs rung las la da bzhengs shig /khyod ni khams gsum srog gi bdag /gsod gcod las la mnga' brnyes shing / /gdug pa'i dregs byed yongs rje ste/ /do nub drag po'i las sgrubs shig /'bar ba'i gtor zor gnyen po 'dir/ /rdzas sngags ting 'dzin kun tshang gis/ /srid gsum rdul du rlog nus na/ /gang la dmigs pa smos ci dgos/ /bhyoḥbhyoḥsdang ba'i dgra la bhyoḥ bhyoḥbhyoḥganod pa'i bgegs la bhyoḥ bhyoḥbhyoḥnd mtshon mu ge bhyoḥ bhyoḥbhyoḥbar chad kun la bhyoḥ zhes bskul nas bzlog pa'i dmag dpung chas pa'i spyan dmigs bcas/ kyai tse'u dmar mched bdun mthu ma chung / /bka' nyan dregs byed rtsal ma zhan/ /las byed shan pa bang ma bul/ /do nub bzlog bsgyur dus la babs/ /log lam 'brid byed lha bdud bzlog /nad gdon sdug bsngal phung bdud bzlog /srid par mtshams sbyor nyon bdud bzlog /tshe la bar chod 'chi bdud bzlog /de la sogs pa bdud chen bzhis/ /snod la skyon gtor 'byung dgra bzlog /bcud la 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs bzlog /de las 'phros pa'i log 'dren kun/ /bstan 'gro'i 'gal rkyen steng du bzlog /ces pa'i mtha' zhag sgrub gnang na 'di yan gyis 'thus/ 'phen pa ltar na de nas sgrub bo/ /drag chas phod ka rus rgyan/ skra tshab dgos min gang 'os/ zhwa nag ro sol tshil chen thugs kar ba'i sna zhur can/ rdor dril thogs la/ rnga rol/ rkang gling / g.yab dar/ khrag chang 'thor ba/ spos dkar tshil chen dud pa/ go mtshon dpung bcas su 'cha' ba'am/

yang na rang rang gi cha lugs des 'thus pas gtor ma lho phyogs la zhal bsgyur tsam lam 'then nas 'di skad do/ /kyai da ni chos shig tse'u dmar/ /dang por dpal chen rta mgrin bka'/ /bar du padma 'byung gnas bka'/ /mtha' mar khyed sgrub rig 'dzin bka'/ /dam tshig rdo rje ma bzhag gam/ /'da' ka'i bdud rtsi ma 'thung ngam/ /khas blang g.yar dam dran gyis la/ /gdug can sgrol ba'i dus la babs/ /zhes rab rnying lugs kyi zor 'chams khungs ldan dang / yang na grub mtha' rang rang gi bla ma gong ma'i zor 'chams khungs ma bcas phyi rol gom pa bzhi bcu zhe dgu las mi nyung ba'i sar sgra gcan thibs phyogs dang bstun pa'am/ yang na gang la dmigs pa de phyogs su gzigs la/ phud phor du gser skyems bshams te/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid rta mgrin thugs ka nas/ /raṃ yaṃ khaṃ las me rlung chu/ /spros pas gser skyems snod bcud rnams/ /bsregs gtor bkrus sbyangs skad cig gis/ /bhrūṃ las rin chen snod mchog tu/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ las dza gad ni/ /kha dog dri ro nus ldan gyis/ /'khor 'das mgron kun dgyes bskyed gyur/ /ho bla ma yi dam chos srung dang / /nor lha gzhi bdag rigs drug 'gro/ /gnod byed kun kyang bdud rtsi 'dis/ /tshim nas bdag gi drag las mdzod/ /ces phyogs bcur gtor/ ma nyes dpang gzugs/ hūm̐ dgongs shig srid zhi'i cho 'phrul rnams/ /yid la gnag pa'i dgra bgegs 'dis/ /nyes byas gang yin khyed rnams dgongs/ /bdag gis ma nyes gzigs su gsol/ /zor lam phye zhing gtor ma 'phang ba ni/ kyai phyogs bcu'i dregs byed phog thug can/ /khyed la bdag ni mi zor bas/ /rang rang phyogs su sku zur la/ /zor lam gnyen po dgra bgegs la/ /phyes zhig ma rungs 'di dag gis/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'jig rten 'tshe/ /bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa dang / /khyad par bdag cag yon mchod la/ /ma nyes tho 'tshams du ma byas/ /mi nor rdzas kun med par gyis/

/rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /zhes phyed gtor ma 'phen pa ni/ hrīḥrang nyid rta mchog dpal gyi mdun/ /mi bzad 'brub khung thar med du/ /bka' nyan las byed pho nya yis/ /sdang dgra gnod bgegs kun bkug gyur/ /kyai da ni bka' dam dus la dbab/ /gtum chen tse'u dmar po khyod/ /mched bdun 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /bka' nyan dmag dpung da chos shig /bhyoḥbhyoḥde ni dgra la bhyoḥ /phyes phyes de ni dmag la phyes/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyogs/ /dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /ces dang gtor ma g.yas g.yon dbus su gsor nas rta mgrin dang / 'di'i sngags gong gi thun sngags rnams kyi mthar dmod pa dang bcas drag tu bstan nas/ gcan gzan gdug pa can gyi pags pa'am/ chos gos sogs sa la brdab/ 'brub khung gi dmigs yul rnams gtor ma me mtshon nad yams dug gi rang bzhin des sha 'dzog rus 'dzog tu btang / rnam par shes pa mar me lta bu der chu blugs pa bzhin nag thum gyis bsad nas rang dang yi dam chos skyong dgra bgegs bcas kyi thugs dang sems ro gcig tu bsres nas gnas lugs gsal stong 'dzin med blo 'das phyag rgya chen pos rjes su bzung nas rang gzhan thams cad 'phral yun gtan bder bkod pa'i dmigs pa dang / las mkhan sprul pa yang sprul sogs kyis dmigs yul de'i yul mkhar mi nor rdzas gsum la dmag drangs nas nad mtshon mu ge'i char bab ste til 'bru tsam yang med par zos/ de dag gi legs tshogs thams cad bsdus nas bdag la ngo gso dang bcas byin pas tshe bsod sogs rgyas par bsams nas rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me 'od bcas kyi srung 'khor nang rang yi dam du gsal ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing mdog gsal btab/ rkang rjes rnams rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsams nas sgrub khang du log ste me tog char bcas bkra shis kyi tshig ci rigs brjod/

sang lta bu gtang rag gsol kha rgyas par phul/ yang bsad las ma yin par nad mtshon mu ge bzlog ched du yin na gzhan 'dra ba las gtor ma 'phen tshe 'brub khung mi bsgom par dmigs bya de la 'phen pas rang bzhin gyi ngang du bzlog par bsam pa tsam khyad par ro/ /brgyud ldan dam pa las 'ongs pa'i/ /man ngag dam pa khrigs su bkod/ /skyes bu dam pa'i thugs bzhed kun/ /ji dgongs dam pa 'grub gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ btsan rgod tsi'u dmar po'i gtor ma'i las mtha' nyung tshang rno myur/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
